content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default applies.

candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is undefined. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. validateLogin then sees provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
Register doesn't set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email when creating the user. It relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
